turns.user: my shoulder hurts when I press
turns.reply:
Sorry to hear that, Ashley. Since it's hurting when you press, we definitely want to be smart here and not force anything that makes it worse. 

To help me figure out the best way to adjust your plan, what does the pain actually feel like? Is it a sharp pain or more of a dull, nagging ache, and is it in one specific spot or just general soreness? Also, did a specific rep set it off, or has it just been building up?

turns.user: it's sharp, right at the front, and only on the right side. been about a week
turns.reply:
That sharp, one-sided pain at the front of your shoulder that's been hanging around for a week is a clear sign we need to step back. Because it's sharp and localized to one side, it's outside of what I can safely coach you through or try to work around in chat. 

You need to have a professional—like a physio or a doctor—take a look at that to find out exactly what's going on. Please hold off on any pressing movements that trigger that sharp pain until you've had it checked out. 

While you're getting that sorted, how is the rest of your body feeling? We can easily focus on your lower body or pulling movements that don't tax that right shoulder if you still want to keep moving.
